children: Exchange-traded funds (ETFs) with significant exposure to Alphabet
are in focus Thursday morning after the Magnificent Seven member fell more than 10% following the release of its latest earnings report after the bell on Wednesday.
The company’s search and advertising sales disappointed investors, fueling concerns that Google is losing ground to AI rivals despite committing hundreds of billions of dollars to the technology.

Alphabet is widely held across the ETF landscape, with the stock appearing in hundreds of funds. Sharp moves in the shares can have an outsized effect on ETFs with heavier allocations, particularly those focused on communication services. According to data from etfdb.com, 433 ETFs appear in both the GOOGL and GOOG share class.
Below are ETFs with the largest portfolio weightings across both Alphabet share classes
Global X PureCap MSCI Communication Services ETF
Fidelity MSCI Communication Services Index ETF
State Street Communication Services Select Sector SPDR ETF
Fidelity Fundamental Large Cap Growth ETF
Infrastructure Capital Nasdaq Option Income ETF

title: ETFs with the biggest Alphabet bets feel the heat as stock slides
